# GKP Artistry & Makeovers
> A luxury bridal makeup and professional makeup academy website.

## Core Files
- `src/routes/__root.tsx`: Main entry layout and global configuration
- `src/router.tsx`: TanStack Router configuration
- `src/routes/`: File-based routing for pages and views
- `src/components/ui/`: Radix-based design system and core UI components
- `graphify-out/`: Graphify dependency analysis and architecture knowledge graph

## Key Concepts
- **TanStack Start & Router**: Handles full-stack SSR routing. The routing structure is heavily dependent on the `src/routes/` directory structure.
- **Design System**: Built on Radix UI primitives with Tailwind CSS v4. Managed mostly through the `cn` utility function.
- **Animations**: Integrates GSAP, Framer Motion, and OGL for rich interactive experiences and transitions. Ensure performance monitoring on high-LCP pages.
- **Forms**: Managed entirely via React Hook Form and validated with Zod, with standardized wrappers in `src/components/ui/form.tsx`.
- **Graphify Analysis**: The graphify knowledge graph tracks codebase architecture. Run `graphify update .` to keep it synced.
